description: This file is a script for managing package publishing in the Notesnook project, including dependency resolution, version bumping, and publishing workflows.

methods.name: publishPackages
methods.description: Coordinates the publishing process for a list of dependencies, including dry run, bumping versions, resolving local packages, and publishing.

methods.name: performTasks
methods.description: Executes a list of tasks with concurrency control, handling errors and output.

methods.name: bumpVersion
methods.description: Runs npm version command to bump the package version.

methods.name: resolveLocalPackages
methods.description: Resolves local file dependencies in package.json and updates them.

methods.name: unresolveLocalPackages
methods.description: Restores original package.json from backup after dependency resolution.

methods.name: publishPackage
methods.description: Publishes a package to npm, optionally as a dry run.

methods.name: findDependencies
methods.description: Recursively finds all dependencies for a given package scope, including local file dependencies.

methods.name: filterDependencies
methods.description: Filters dependencies that are local file dependencies.

methods.name: resolveDependencies
methods.description: Resolves local file dependencies to version strings.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a shell command and captures output.
